inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Detect Entra ID OAuth Phishing via MAB to DRS

properties.description: Detects a user initiating an OAuth flow with the Microsoft Authentication Broker (MAB) client to the Device Registration Service (DRS) from multiple IP addresses within a short time window. This pattern is indicative of an adversary using a phished authorization code to begin the process of registering a malicious device in the target tenant, a key step for establishing persistence. The rule specifically looks for sessions that involve at least one browser-based request, which is common in the initial phishing stage.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Detect Entra ID OAuth Phishing via MAB to DRS
properties.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
// Filter for successful sign-ins targeting the Device Registration Service with the Microsoft Authentication Broker client.
| where ResultType == 0
| where AppId == "29d9ed98-a469-4536-ade2-f981bc1d605e" // Microsoft Authentication Broker (MAB)
| where ResourceIdentity == "01cb2876-7ebd-4aa4-9cc9-d28bd4d359a9" // Device Registration Service (DRS)
// The authentication was performed using a refresh token.
| where IncomingTokenType == "refreshToken"
// The token was specifically scoped for Azure DRS access.
| where AuthenticationProcessingDetails has "adrs_access"
| project-reorder
    TimeGenerated,
    UserPrincipalName,
    AppDisplayName,
    IPAddress,
    Location,
    ResourceDisplayName,
    AuthenticationProcessingDetails,
    DeviceDetail,
    UserAgent,
    CorrelationId
